source_refs.note: Topic 4.1.3.4 Balancing Parentheses (PDF 99, printed 96). Short question 4 is answered.

blocks.text: When dealing with infix expressions, parentheses are used to show which operations should be done first. Balancing parentheses is important to ensure that every opening parenthesis has a matching closing parenthesis.

items: Use a stack to keep track of opening parentheses.
When you find an opening parenthesis (, push it onto the stack.
When you find a closing parenthesis ), pop the top of the stack.
If the stack is empty after processing all parentheses, they are balanced.
If the stack is not empty, or if you try to pop from an empty stack, the parentheses are not balanced.

blocks.text: Example: For the expression (3 + 4) * (5 - 2), the parentheses are balanced. Each ( has a matching ).
